list.text: I can see it...\nEverything there is to see about you...
You're strong because you believe in your Pokemon.
There's no cheating with Pokemon.\nLet's keep it fair and square!
I fought fair and square.\nI don't regret this at all.
It itches and tickles a bit when I wear shorts in the grass.
I'm going to catch more Pokemon in the grass.
I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning.

lines: EndSpeech: Meu Pokémon precisa ser forte!

list.text: There's a fat Pokemon that comes from the mountains.\nI'll get stronger if I catch it.
